rationale: This adds one unit test to tools/scripts/test_fetch_skia_for_release_extra.py for the Skia download fallback. The test checks that a 404 or 5xx from the GitHub API release lookup keeps the job token and is never repeated anonymously; only a 401 or 403 drops it. No script, pinned asset, hash, download source or unpacked layout changes, so no Skia backend, render surface or captured output moves. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves; the disposition is watch-only.
